title: Patient Admission Procedure
content:
SOP: Patient Admission Procedure (SOP-ADM-001)
DEPARTMENT: Admission and Discharge
VERSION: 3.1
ROLES: front_office, admission, nurse, doctor
PURPOSE: Standardize inpatient admission workflow and bed allocation.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 7: Execute phase 7 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 8: Execute phase 8 of Patient Admission Procedure in full compliance with Admission and Discharge hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Admission and Discharge.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-ADM-001 Patient Admission Procedure v3.1, Section 4
